message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case: illegal excavation of cultural relics (ancient tombs). Crimes: illegal excavation of cultural relics (破坏文物罪) maybe "非法盗掘古墓葬" which is under Criminal Law article 362? Actually Chinese law: "非法买卖文物罪" and "破坏文物罪". The act is illegal excavation of tombs, which is "盗掘古墓" considered "破坏文物罪" (illegal excavation of cultural relics). Also possibly "组织、领导、参加盗掘古墓" which is "盗掘古墓罪". The typical charge: "盗掘古墓罪" (illegal excavation of tombs). Also maybe "非法买卖文物罪" if they sold, but not mentioned. So only one crime: 盗掘古墓罪 (illegal excavation of ancient tombs). In examples they used "盗窃;诈骗" etc. For cultural relics they used "破坏广播电视设施、公用电信设施;盗窃". Not relevant. Another example: "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;协助组织卖淫". So multiple crimes separated by semicolon.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗掘古墓罪<eoa>.

Check if also "非法收购、买卖文物" not present. So single.
